I tried to get a free vacation at a presentation in Vegas and I told them I was single and had no savings and could not afford the $1000 downpayment and they didn't care. if I sat through the presentation I could receive a 2night voucher to Wyndham Las Vegas. I sat through the presentation and then when I asked for the voucher they refused to give it to me unless I sat with a counselor to look at contracts. comments.text: Just be straight up when you go to the presentation.  They say 90 minutes -say you’re leaving after 90 minutes and time it.  Then when that’s up - say you’re leaving.  Keep saying no.
